DateRangeRequest.title: DateRangeRequest
DateRangeRequest.description:
Date range specification for metrics queries.

Supports two modes:
1. Explicit dates: Provide start_date (required) and optionally end_date
2. Period shorthand: Provide period (YTD, QTD, MTD, WTD, DTD)

Only one mode can be used at a time. If neither is provided, defaults to YTD.
All date calculations use EST timezone (America/New_York).

Mode-exclusivity validation is inherited from ``BaseDateRangeRequest``;
fields below are re-declared only to attach OpenAPI examples.

period.title: Period
period.description: Period shorthand that was requested (if any)

DateRangeResponse.title: DateRangeResponse
DateRangeResponse.description:
Date range for response metadata with resolved dates.

Unlike DateRangeRequest, this model allows all three fields to be present
since it shows both what was requested (period) and what was resolved (dates).
Resolved ``start_date``/``end_date`` are inherited from
``BaseDateRangeResponse``.

MarketCapDistributionRequest.title: MarketCapDistributionRequest
MarketCapDistributionRequest.description:
Request model for Market Cap Distribution metrics

This endpoint provides company-netted GMV percent NAV distribution statistics.
Returns two datasets in a single response:
1. Grouped by company_netted_direction only (summary)
2. Grouped by company_netted_direction and market_cap (detail)

Company netting: net exposure is summed by (issuer_id, illiquid_private)
to produce a company-level netted exposure, then ABS() is taken to compute GMV.

PerformanceOverviewRequest.title: PerformanceOverviewRequest
PerformanceOverviewRequest.description:
Request model for Performance Overview metrics

This endpoint groups by date and one additional dimension to provide
time-series cumulative PnL or alpha data.

Supported metrics:
- cumulative_pnl_percent_nav (default): Geometric cumulative PnL as % of NAV
- cumulative_simple_alpha_pnl_percent_nav: PnL% minus benchmark cumulative return
- cumulative_net_adjusted_alpha_pnl_percent_nav: PnL% minus (benchmark% × avg net exposure%)
